---

**Weave Reality (Su):** The solipsist gains an additional daily use of weave reality at 4th level and 14th level. She also gains access to the following weave reality options.

- **Disbelieve Reality:** At 14th level, the solipsist can spend a use of weave reality to treat one creature or object she can perceive as if it were a figment for 1 round per shadow weaver level. She can't touch the chosen creature or object and it cannot touch her, each passing through the other as if the other were an intangible figment. This weave reality option replaces the piercing glimpse gained at 14th level.
- **Dispel Matter:** At 18th level, the solipsist can spend a use of weave reality to dispel one object fitting within one 10-foot cube per shadow weaver level or one creature of any size. The target must be within 100 feet + 10 feet per shadow weaver level and must make a Fortitude saving throw. If target fails and has no more hit points than 50 + 5 per shadow weaver level, or if it succeeds and has 20 or fewer hit points, its physical form is utterly erased from existence. This weave reality option replaces weave matter.

**Avid Learner:** A solipsist cannot gain divination spells with avid learner. This ability alters avid learner.

**Self-Centered Reality (Ex):** Starting at 4th level, the solipsist refuses to accept aspects of reality she dislikes and her disbelief blunts their effects. She gains damage reduction 1/—. Whenever she attempts a saving throw, she can make a Will saving throw to disbelieve the attack as an immediate action by spending a use of weave reality. If the attack was an illusion, treat this as her normal save to disbelieve it; if the attack wasn't an illusion, she gains this chance to disbelieve anyway. If she disbelieves a non-illusion this way, she treats it as only 80% real; nondamaging effects have only an 80% chance of applying to her, and any damage it deals to her is reduced to 80% normal. At 9th level, her damage reduction improves to 3/— and a non-illusion she disbelieves is reduced to 60% real. At 19th level, her damage reduction improves to 5/— and a non-illusion she disbelieves is reduced to 40% real.

This ability replaces the piercing glimpses gained at 4th level, 9th level, and 19th level.

**Seeing is Believing (Su):** At 8th level, the solipsist can use overwhelm disbelief on any target she can see. This ability alters overwhelm disbelief and replaces vital duality.
